physicalNotes: Radius 1.627 Jupiter radii from Jofré et al. 2025 (2025MNRAS.544.3994J), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.544.3994J/abstract): 116,317.5 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 1.018 Jupiter masses (Jofré et al. 2025, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2025MNRAS.544.3994J), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.544.3994J/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
